title.narrative: Reducing Climate Impact of Cooking in Rwanda through Improved Cooking Energy Systems (ReCIC)

description.narrative: The overall objective of the Action is to reduce the climate impact of cooking systems. The specific objectives of the Action are to (i) increase the use of improved cooking technol-ogies by the population of Rwanda and (ii) reduce the biomass consumption for cooking purposes.
